tweet.text:
After all this nonsense, I hope open models overtake both of them. The doomsaying is getting old, and with Anthropic specifically, I'm tired of their frontier models blocking meaningful work in the bio space.

My wife has brain cancer. I can't use Fable 5 or Fable 5.1 to ask questions about her cancer data. The moment I try, I get rolled back to Opus 5, a far weaker model.

I'm a husband turning over every stone I can find to keep my wife alive. I ask things like "how do we target this mutation in her tumor," and that's a bridge too far for @AnthropicAI and @claudeai. Instant Opus rollback.

I cannot square "our models are so advanced they might kill everyone" with "Fable 5.1 won't answer your wife's cancer questions, enjoy Opus, because our models are so advanced they can't tell a bioweapon prompt from a husband asking about his wife's tumor." Pick one.

For a company that talks about curing cancer in the next few years, it's an interesting way of going about
